indications: Verkazia ophthalmic emulsion is indicated for the treatment of vernal keratoconjunctivitis (VKC) in children and adults.
contraindications: Instill one drop of Verkazia, 4 times daily (morning, noon, afternoon, and evening) in each affected eye ( 2 )
warningsAndPrecautions:
Verkazia (cyclosporine ophthalmic emulsion) 0.1% is packaged in low-density polyethylene single-dose vials. Each vial contains 0.3 mL fill; 5 vials are packaged in an aluminum pouch; 24 pouches are packaged in a box of 120 vials.
                  
                  
                     The entire contents of each box of 120 vials must be dispensed intact.
                  
                  
                     120 Single-Dose Vials 0.3 mL each — NDC 82667-014-01
                  
                  Storage: Do not freeze Verkazia. Store at 20°C to 25°C (68°F to 77°F). After opening the aluminum pouch, the single-dose vial should be kept in the pouch to protect from light and avoid evaporation. Any opened individual single-dose vial with any remaining emulsion should be discarded immediately after use.
name: Verkazia
